Reason for the Update
Confirmation of the NZD/AUD exchange rate used for the FY26 final dividend of the company to be paid on 30 September
2026.
Additional Information
The foreign exchange rate used for the FY26 final dividend of the company payable to Australian investors in Australian
Dollars (NZD/AUD) has been set to 0.8032. The dividend will be paid on 30 September 2026.

Start Date
7/9/2026
End Date
11/9/2026
4A.5 DRP price calculation methodology
The price is calculated as the average of the daily volume weighted average sale price for a share (expressed in cents
and fractions of a cent) calculated on all sales of shares which took place through the NZX Main Board on the five trading
days commencing on 7 September 2026 in accordance with the DRP terms and conditions.
4A.6 DRP Price (including any discount):
NZD 6.54140

4A.11 Are there any other conditions applying to DRP participation?
4A.11a Conditions for DRP participation
The DRP is only available to holders of shares who have an address on the Mercury share register in New Zealand or
Australia. The full terms and conditions of the DRP are set out in the DRP Offer Document at the link below. 
4A.12 Link to a copy of the DRP plan rules
https://www.mercury.co.nz/investors/dividends
4A.13 Further information about the DRP
Security holders who participate in the DRP will receive fully paid ordinary shares by way of issue of new shares. 
Part 5 - Further information
5.1 Please provide any further information applicable to this dividend/distribution
The total dividend/distribution amount per security referred to in 2A.9 relates to an ordinary dividend of NZD 0.17000000
plus a supplementary dividend of NZD 0.03000000 payable to non-New Zealand resident shareholders. 
5.2 Additional information for inclusion in the Announcement Summary
The foreign exchange rate used for the FY26 final dividend of the company payable to Australian investors in Australian
Dollars (NZD/AUD) has been set to 0.8032. The dividend will be paid on 30 September 2026.
